name: 23970 · South Hill, VA
findings: ZIP 23970 (South Hill) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (83% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23970 (South Hill) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
